Subject: Deal Desk recommendation — BrightHealth 3-year price lock (requesting exec approval)

Evelyn / Jordan —

Summary: BrightHealth requests a 3-year price lock with an uplift cap at renewal (they requested 8%). Deal Desk recommends approval with limited concessions and the following guardrails.

Recommended terms (Deal Desk):
- Term: 36 months, firm price lock for committed SKU list.
- Uplift cap at renewal: 5% per year (counter to customer 8%).
- Renewal protection: no re-pricing unless usage increases by >40% (we propose 40% to be conservative) or customer adopts materially different product bundles.
- Limited grandfathering: rates for committed SKUs remain in effect for first renewal; any expansion SKUs priced at prevailing list.
- Finance requirement: CFO sign-off on revenue recognition if customer insists on longer price guarantees beyond 36 months.

Rationale: 5% cap balances customer predictability and our ability to maintain unit economics given hardware and model cost variability. Raising the usage threshold from 30% to 40% protects against small usage noise being treated as a material change.

Ask: Exec approval to accept a 5% uplift cap and 40% usage trigger. If exec prefers to accept 8% (customer ask), we need explicit sign-off on a compensating concession (e.g., a higher commit or a non-refundable portion of the ARR).

Attachments: term-redline-3yr.docx, BrightHealth-TermSheet-3yr-draft.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
